Addendum <Ordinance No. 738, February 13, 1999>
(1) (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.
(2) (Transitional Measures concerning Designation) The previous provisions shall apply to schools for which an application for designation was filed and the designation procedure was in progress at the time these Rules enter into force.
(3) (Transitional Measures concerning Schools Already Designated) Schools designated under the previous Rules on Designation of Schools Recognized as Providing Academic Qualifications for Admission to Higher-Level Schools at the time these Rules enter into force shall be deemed designated under these Rules.
(4) (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations) Where other statutes or regulations in force at the time these Rules enter into force cite the previous Rules on Designation of Schools Recognized as Providing Academic Qualifications for Admission to Higher-Level Schools or any provisions thereof, and corresponding provisions exist in these Rules, the citations shall be deemed to refer to these Rules or the corresponding provisions hereof in place of the previous Rules or provisions.
